blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Restore a legal Alpha-first deployment and uninterrupted 3/5/10 encounter path on the preserved authored map, then make three-cycle target-resolution performance evidence retainable while repairing the initial HUD collision.

diagnosis.root_cause: The primary blocker is a semantic wrapper-binding error: the preserved authored map is intact, but ProductAnchors/Deployment is approximately 6.8 m from Charlie and 61.5 m from Alpha, so the direct binding correctly deploys the player at the wrong end of the mission. This prevents uninterrupted A→B→C combat and lifecycle verification. The performance gap is not evidence of a confirmed slowdown: the current qualification observer hard-codes 1920×1080 instead of proving the active viewport and discards prior cycles' raw frame samples, retaining only summaries, so three-cycle target-resolution qualification cannot be established. The initial route hint/C LOCKED collision is a separate bounded responsive-layout defect.

stop_conditions: Stop the route repair if it would require moving, duplicating, extracting, hiding, or editing authored map children, replacing native streets, adding proxy floors, or changing the preserved map datum.

If no direct native-street deployment/Alpha binding meets collision, connectivity, first-escape, sightline, and 30–45 second route requirements, retain the failed diagnostic receipt and report the exact native topology blocker; do not resume runtime offset search or transform tuning.
Do not claim a performance fix from hard-coded resolution metadata, averages alone, a short sample, or fewer than three complete lifecycle cycles.
Stop and repair before handoff if clean boot regresses, late candidate-script errors appear, stable enemy identities change across lifecycle resets, or default ui_scale no longer persists as 1.0.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause strategy from prior transform tuning. Direct map-instance restoration is unnecessary because the intact authored environment is already preserved; replacement is disallowed by the binding; isolation would leave progression unusable. Repair the product-owned semantic anchor wrapper atomically so Deployment denotes a real Alpha approach on the existing navigation datum, with no runtime offset search. Separately improve observation rather than guessing at performance: retain actual-viewport, per-cycle raw timing and cleanup evidence, and limit the adjacent player-facing change to the active initial-HUD collision.

code: Developer: run project parse/resource-load and clean-boot checks after edits; verify no authored environment source/import, authored child transform, input binding, weapon package, or mission authority was changed.

Developer: inspect route/occupancy receipts for bounded size, stable IDs, direct-anchor mode and explicit failure reasons; inspect qualification output for actual viewport, three retained cycle IDs and bounded raw-sample access.
Developer: read late runtime/editor errors after route traversal, combat, capture, F6, checkpoint restore, Replay and terminal callbacks.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime/Tester: from a fresh deployment, use ordinary input to prove a 30–45 second spawn→Alpha traversal followed by uninterrupted 3 Alpha, 5 Bravo and 10 Charlie encounters. Capture adjacent actor-state samples for perception, search, movement, avoidance, aim telegraph, fire, reload, hurt and death.

GameLoop Runtime/Tester: validate every stable hostile at initial spawn and after F6/checkpoint/Replay for full-capsule clearance, floor/navigation support, nearest-neighbour distance ≥1.40 m, doorway progress, body-before-shot visibility and reciprocal static-world occlusion.

GameLoop Runtime/Tester: run the complete mission at an observed 1920×1080 after load for three restart/replay cycles. Collect raw frame times, phase aggregates, explosion frames, cleanup/lifecycle deltas and final logs; require approximately 60 FPS and no explosion streak of three frames below 45 FPS.

GameLoop Runtime/Tester: perform the mandatory FPS patrol with advancing game time: mouse yaw/pitch plus movement, ADS/fire/release, reload-only R, F6 reset, pause/resume, sustained-fire recoil return, Home, Replay and checkpoint recovery, without process-restart recovery. Also retain non-blocking patrol observations for viewmodel hand contact, environment exposure and natural walking Foley.
visual: Capture matched first-person views at deployment, first Alpha contact, Alpha, Bravo and Charlie; verify the map remains intact, C is not visible from deployment, objectives sit on native walkable surfaces, and enemies occupy multiple routes and elevations without wall embedding.

Capture initial gameplay at 1280×720 and ui_scale=1.0 with both route hint and C LOCKED visible, then the same HUD state at ui_scale=2.0, and finally a restarted ui_scale=1.0 frame. Require separate safe-area placement, no clipping, no boxed narrative copy, and no reticle/viewmodel occlusion.

During the bounded regression patrol, compare daylight material detail, sky/shadows/SSAO/clouds/flare independently and inspect the AK-74M support-hand contact; record regressions without expanding the two implementation tasks.

done_when: A fresh deployment binds to a collision-backed native street on the Alpha approach, Charlie is neither nearby nor in the first sightline, and the intact authored environment remains one unchanged authoritative instance.

The direct deployment/Alpha transaction uses one authored navigation datum with no offset search; all A/B/C anchors are walkable, capsule-clear and connected, and ordinary input reaches the first legal Alpha overlap in 30–45 seconds.

Mission progression remains strictly A→B→C: Alpha enemies provide pressure before the capture center, Bravo and Charlie activate only at their legal stages, and the roster retains exactly 3/5/10 stable identities without teleporting one actor between roles.

Initial spawn, F6, checkpoint restore and Replay preserve player/enemy occupancy. Every hostile has full-capsule floor/navigation support, no active pair falls below the 1.40 m separation threshold during sampled movement, and shot authorization rejects a muzzle/capsule embedded in static geometry.

Route, roster and occupancy state expose bounded receipts sufficient for Tester to correlate stable actor IDs, activation regions, route milestones, nearest-neighbour minima, grounded occupancy and reciprocal static-world occlusion without creating mission truth.
